programs.desc: An unidentified metal object is found on Kiska Island; a centuries-old gold mining mystery is investigated; in Siberia, a network of ice tunnels is explored; fossils unearthed in the Canadian Arctic lead to the discovery of a new species.

programs.title: Secrets in the Ice
programs.desc: Archaeologists discover human remains during an excavation of a fifth-century fort on the Swedish island of Öland; after further investigation, experts unearth 26 skeletons and uncover the site of an ancient massacre.

programs.title: Strange Evidence
programs.desc: A bizarre, tentacled black mass emerges from the seas on an island in the Caribbean, and on-lookers are horrified as it writhes ashore; experts use cutting-edge tech to investigate the origin of this alien invader.

programs.title: Strange Evidence
programs.desc: A man sees a doctor complaining of agonizing facial pain, and when they investigate, they discover a strange parasitic species living deep in the man's nose; footage of the grisly encounter reveals what happened next.

programs.title: Strange Evidence
programs.desc: Footage of a wolf-like creature in the remote wilderness of northern Canada could be evidence of a dire wolf, a prehistoric beast that went extinct at the end of the last Ice Age; experts use cutting-edge technology to investigate if it has returned.
